estimatr: Fast Estimators for Design-Based Inference

Source: R/estimatr-package.R
estimatr-package.Rd

Fast procedures for a small set of commonly-used, design-appropriate estimators with robust standard errors and confidence intervals. Provides lm_robust, lm_lin, iv_robust, lh_robust, difference_in_means, and horvitz_thompson, with feols-style fixed effects absorption and design-aware Horvitz-Thompson variance. See vignette("estimatr2.0") for what changes in version 2.0 and what does not.
